name: github-sync-api

dependencies.name: github
dependencies.description: Exchanges the Administrator's OAuth code for an access token, lists their repositories, and polls each watched repository's open issues labeled critical.

dependencies.name: google-chat
dependencies.description: Posts a notification message when a new critical issue is found on a watched repository.

description: Backend for the GitHub-to-Google-Chat critical issue sync. Owns the watched-repository list, the Google Chat destination, the Administrator's GitHub OAuth connection, and the periodic poll that detects new critical issues and posts a notification exactly once per issue. Exposes the API the admin web app calls; does not render any UI and never writes back to GitHub.
